chapterInfo.content:
6
Mmara nsɛm kɛseɛ no
1Na yei ne mmara nsɛm, ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ sɛ wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ mo na monyɛ asase a moretwam akɔfa no soɔ, 2na woasuro AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn adi n’ahyɛdeɛ ne ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ woɔ yi nyinaa so, wo ne wo ba ne wo ba ba, wo nkwa nna nyinaa, na wo nna aware. 3Enti, Israel, tie, na hwɛ yɛ, na asi wo yie, na woadɔɔso pii, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo nananom Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ woɔ no, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene soɔ no so. 4#Mar 12.29; 1 Ko 8.4, 6 Israel, tie, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ AWURADE koro. 5#Deut 10.12; Mat 22.37 Na fa w’akoma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa ne w’ahoɔden nyinaa dɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn. 6#Deut 11.18-20 Na nsɛm yi a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nna w’akoma so; 7#Gye 18.19 na fa kyerɛkyerɛ wo mma yie, na kasa ho, w’afitena mu ne wo kwan so nanteɛ mu ne wo nna mu ne wo sɔreɛ mu; 8#Eks 13.9 na fa yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ kyekyere wo nsa, na ɛnyɛ w’aniwa ntam nkaeɛ abotire; 9na twerɛ gu wo fie aponnwa ho ne w’aponkɛseɛ so.
Asoɔden ho kɔkɔbɔ
10Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nya de wo duru asase a ɔkaa wo nananom Abraham, Isak ne Yakob ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ no so, nkuro akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛnyɛ wo na wokyekyereeɛ, 11#Deut 8.10 ne adan a nnepa nyinaa ayɛ no amaama a ɛnyɛ wo na wode hyehyɛɛ mu, ne mmura a wɔatutuo a ɛnyɛ wo na wotutuiɛ, bobe nturo ne ngodua nturo a ɛnyɛ wo na wotetɛeɛ, na sɛ wodidi mee a, 12hwɛ yie na wo werɛ amfiri AWURADE a ɔyii wo Misraim asase so firii nkoafie mu no: 13#Deut 10.20; Mat 4.10 AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na suro no, na ɔno na som no, na ne din ho ntam na ka; 14monnni anyame foforɔ a wɔfiri amanaman a wɔgugu mo ho no anyame no akyi; 15#Eks 20.5 na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔwɔ wo mu no yɛ Onyankopɔn ninkufoɔ, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn abufuo annɛre antia wo, na wansɛe wo amfiri asase ani.
16 # Mat 4.7; Eks 17.2, 7 Monnsɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ, sɛdeɛ mosɔɔ no hwɛɛ Masa hɔ no; 17monni AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm ne n’adansesɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a wahyɛ mo no so pɛpɛɛpɛ; 18na yɛ deɛ ɛtene na ɛyɛ AWURADE ani soɔ, na asi wo yie, na woakɔ akɔfa asase pa a AWURADE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom no, 19#Eks 23.27-28 na watu w’atamfo nyinaa afiri w’anim, sɛdeɛ AWURADE kaeɛ no.
20 # Eks 13.14 Sɛ ɔkyena bi, wo ba bisa wo sɛ: Adansesɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ bɛn na AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn de hyɛɛ mo yi? 21#Dwom 44.1 Ka kyerɛ wo ba no sɛ: Na anka yɛyɛ Farao nkoa Misraim, na AWURADE de nsa a ɛyɛ den yii yɛn firii Misraim; 22na AWURADE maa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ hu baa Misraim, Farao ne ne fie nyinaa so wɔ yɛn anim; 23na yɛn deɛ, ɔyii yɛn firii hɔ sɛ ɔde yɛn reba de asase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ yɛn nananom no abɛma yɛn. 24Na AWURADE hyɛɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnyɛ ahyɛdeɛ yi nyinaa na yɛnsuro AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn, na ɛnsi yɛn yie nna nyinaa, na ɔmma yɛnnya nkwa, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi; 25na sɛ yɛhwɛ di mmara nsɛm yi nyinaa so, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn anim, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ yɛn no a, ɛbɛyɛ yɛn ateneneefoɔ.

Na yei ne mmara nsɛm, ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ahyɛ sɛ wɔnkyerɛkyerɛ mo na monyɛ asase a moretwam akɔfa no soɔ, na woasuro AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn adi n’ahyɛdeɛ ne ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ woɔ yi nyinaa so, wo ne wo ba ne wo ba ba, wo nkwa nna nyinaa, na wo nna aware. Enti, Israel, tie, na hwɛ yɛ, na asi wo yie, na woadɔɔso pii, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo nananom Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ woɔ no, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene soɔ no so. Israel, tie, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ AWURADE koro. Na fa w’akoma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa ne w’ahoɔden nyinaa dɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn. Na nsɛm yi a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nna w’akoma so; na fa kyerɛkyerɛ wo mma yie, na kasa ho, w’afitena mu ne wo kwan so nanteɛ mu ne wo nna mu ne wo sɔreɛ mu; na fa yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ kyekyere wo nsa, na ɛnyɛ w’aniwa ntam nkaeɛ abotire; na twerɛ gu wo fie aponnwa ho ne w’aponkɛseɛ so.

Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nya de wo duru asase a ɔkaa wo nananom Abraham, Isak ne Yakob ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ no so, nkuro akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛnyɛ wo na wokyekyereeɛ, ne adan a nnepa nyinaa ayɛ no amaama a ɛnyɛ wo na wode hyehyɛɛ mu, ne mmura a wɔatutuo a ɛnyɛ wo na wotutuiɛ, bobe nturo ne ngodua nturo a ɛnyɛ wo na wotetɛeɛ, na sɛ wodidi mee a, hwɛ yie na wo werɛ amfiri AWURADE a ɔyii wo Misraim asase so firii nkoafie mu no: AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na suro no, na ɔno na som no, na ne din ho ntam na ka; monnni anyame foforɔ a wɔfiri amanaman a wɔgugu mo ho no anyame no akyi; na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔwɔ wo mu no yɛ Onyankopɔn ninkufoɔ, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn abufuo annɛre antia wo, na wansɛe wo amfiri asase ani.
Monnsɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nnhwɛ, sɛdeɛ mosɔɔ no hwɛɛ Masa hɔ no; monni AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm ne n’adansesɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a wahyɛ mo no so pɛpɛɛpɛ; na yɛ deɛ ɛtene na ɛyɛ AWURADE ani soɔ, na asi wo yie, na woakɔ akɔfa asase pa a AWURADE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom no, na watu w’atamfo nyinaa afiri w’anim, sɛdeɛ AWURADE kaeɛ no.
Sɛ ɔkyena bi, wo ba bisa wo sɛ: Adansesɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ bɛn na AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn de hyɛɛ mo yi? Ka kyerɛ wo ba no sɛ: Na anka yɛyɛ Farao nkoa Misraim, na AWURADE de nsa a ɛyɛ den yii yɛn firii Misraim; na AWURADE maa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ hu baa Misraim, Farao ne ne fie nyinaa so wɔ yɛn anim; na yɛn deɛ, ɔyii yɛn firii hɔ sɛ ɔde yɛn reba de asase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ yɛn nananom no abɛma yɛn. Na AWURADE hyɛɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnyɛ ahyɛdeɛ yi nyinaa na yɛnsuro AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn, na ɛnsi yɛn yie nna nyinaa, na ɔmma yɛnnya nkwa, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi; na sɛ yɛhwɛ di mmara nsɛm yi nyinaa so, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn anim, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ yɛn no a, ɛbɛyɛ yɛn ateneneefoɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
